locations.description: Near a corpse on a small ledge.

locations.title: 4x Creeper
locations.description: Ambush you after opening the [Box](#loc=469714).

locations.title: Tentacle
locations.description: In the corridor.

locations.title: Machine Hive
locations.description: Blocking the path ahead.

locations.title: 3x Lump
locations.description: One is lurking in a side-room under the walkway.

locations.title: Sentryborg
locations.description: On top of the platform.

locations.title: Sentryborg
locations.description: On top of the thin walkway.

locations.title: 5x Creeper
locations.description: On the walkway.

locations.title: 1x Droid & 1x Heavy Droid
locations.description: Appear after a cutscene that plays when you reach the third floor.

locations.title: 1x Lump & 2x Tentacle
locations.description: On the fourth floor.

locations.title: Heavy Droid
locations.description: Patrolling the corridor.

locations.title: 1x Battle Droid & 1x Air Drone
locations.description: Burst out of the corridor on the left as you enter the neighboring room for the first time.

locations.title: Water Gate Controls
locations.description: In the small room near the [Camp](#loc=469441).

locations.title: Password-Protected Door
locations.description:
At the end of the [Ledges](#loc=469443) on top of the dam.

The password (lθγηκλ) is found through a door behind the water [here](#loc=469448).

locations.title: Generator #1
locations.description:
At the edge of the lower area, guarded by [1x Sentryborg & 1x Droid](#loc=469469)

One of four generators needed to activate the [Hypertube Door Controls](#loc=469471)

locations.title: Hypertube Door Controls
locations.description:
Next to a ladder on top of the platform. To use it, you'll need to activate:
- [Generator #1](#loc=469470)
- [Generator #2](#loc=469472)
- [Generator #3](#loc=469478)
- [Generator #4](#loc=469481)

This will then open the large door at the top of the nearby ladder.

locations.title: Generator #2
locations.description:
At the top of some steps in the lower area, guarded by [1x Sentryborg & 1x Droid](#loc=469473)

One of four generators needed to activate the [Hypertube Door Controls](#loc=469471)

locations.title: Generator #3
locations.description:
At the edge of the lower area, near [2x Heavy Droid, 2x Sentryborg & 1x Droid](#loc=469474)

One of four generators needed to activate the [Hypertube Door Controls](#loc=469471)

locations.title: Generator #4
locations.description:
At the top of the stairs, protected by [1x Battle Droid & 1x Air Drone](#loc=469480)

One of four generators needed to activate the [Hypertube Door Controls](#loc=469471)

locations.title: Locked Gate
locations.description:
At the leftmost edge of the area.

Its password (**ηεγβεγ**) is found on a [nearby corpse.](#loc=469649)

locations.title: Powerless Gate
locations.description: At the rightmost edge of the area - opens after using the [Power Panel](#loc=469659).

locations.title: Power Panel
locations.description: In the side-room. Restores power to the [Powerless Gate](#loc=469653), and opens the side-rooms in the main corridor, after directing the circuits through their corresponding circles.

locations.title: Laser Panel
locations.description: On the wall in the side-room. Use it to avoid an untimely death and claim the [Black Rose](#loc=469697).

locations.title: Powerless Elevator
locations.description: Activate the [Power Panel](#loc=469727) to use it.

locations.title: Power Panel
locations.description: In the side-room that opens after killing [Belial](#loc=469723). Restores power to the [Powerless Elevator](#loc=469722), after directing the circuits through their corresponding circles.

locations.title: Button
locations.description: Sends you to the next area.

locations.title: Arisa
locations.description: Standing in the middle of the room. Speak to her, and she'll open the stairwell that leads to the second floor.

locations.title: Locked Door
locations.description: Opens after [Karakuri](#loc=469988) is defeated.

locations.title: Elevator Button
locations.description: On your left when the doors open.
